images.name: G03_level2_the_stepwell
images.final_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Polished promotional key art for this Roblox co-op horror game. Rebuild the actual architecture, colours and materials of the supplied environment reference images with cinematic practical daylight, depth, slight haze and fine film grain. Faithful game geometry, not generic fantasy architecture. Every player is the same stylised chunky game avatar about three heads tall: mustard-yellow hooded hazmat suit of crumpled fabric, hood up, black gas mask with TWO ROUND LENSES and one round front filter (when face is visible), black backpack straps, black pouch belt, black tactical backpack with two small olive side tanks, black mitten gloves, chunky black boots. Match the supplied player reference; never realistic human proportions, bare face or clear visor. All players fully inside frame. Level 2: no monster, creature, entity, foam, gore, weapons, invented props or extra people. NO LETTERING of any kind: no title, caption, logo, watermark, numbers, signs, HUD, UI or key hints. Calm darker copy space must be integrated naturally into the scene, not a panel. One clear composition that reads at thumbnail size. Reference images are visual references, not edit targets.
Format: 3:2 widest landscape. Keep all important subjects in middle 80% of image height for later centre crop to 16:9.
Scene and composition: The immense stepwell of the reference, looking down and across it: cream plaster walls of zig-zag stair flights with glass rails and arched doorways, tier under tier, down to a still green pool far below; the slender round pillar and the stair tower at one side. Two tiny players walk down a flight in the middle distance, one behind the other. Soft warm daylight from above, long shadows. Nothing else alive.
Leave the LOWER-LEFT corner (about a third of the width, a fifth of the height) calm and darker for a small "LEVEL" line. No lettering.
images.remaining_issue: The two players are nearer and larger than the requested tiny middle-distance figures, and the stair tower is not clearly separate.
